profile_text.body:
Leidos is a public company, traded under the ticker LDOS, that describes itself as a Fortune 500 digital and mission innovator delivering solutions at the intersection of national security, health, and critical infrastructure. Its site says it has a global workforce of approximately 47,000 and that it is carrying out a NorthStar 2030 strategy built on five growth engines: space and maritime, energy infrastructure, digital modernization and cyber, mission software, and managed health. The company also says it is recruiting in North Alabama, which it calls a center for defense, aerospace, and manufacturing.

The site does not name specific AI products. Its stated growth areas include digital modernization and cyber and mission software, and it frames its work around national security, health, and critical infrastructure rather than around AI offerings as such. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for the company. Its registration details list a CIK of 0001336920 and its website as leidos.com.
